type.provenance: Prohibit the manufacture, sale, or distribution for sale or use of wraps and liners, plates, food boats, and pizza boxes that contain PFAS; and Prohibit the manufacture, sale, distribution, and use of class B firefighting foams that contain PFAS, with certain exceptions.

date.provenance: Beginning July 1, 2024, it shall be unlawful...

who.provenance: A manufacturer of class B firefighting foam prohibited by this part shall notify, in writing...; A manufacturer that produces, sells, or distributes a class B firefighting foam prohibited by this part shall recall the product...

action.provenance: Prohibit the manufacture, sale, distribution, and use...

products.provenance: Prohibition applies to wraps and liners, plates, food boats, pizza boxes, and class B firefighting foams

value: use necessary for effective suppression of a petroleum fire
use required by federal law or regulations
exceptions.provenance: Prohibition does not apply to use necessary for effective suppression of a petroleum fire; Prohibition does not apply to manufacture, sale, or distribution of class B firefighting foam where inclusion of PFAS chemicals is required by federal law or regulations

currently_unavoidable.provenance: PFAS have been detected in drinking water and have been found in food packaging, indicating that the PFAS is currently unavoidable in these products

intentionally_added.provenance: Intentionally introduced PFAS chemicals have been used in the formulation of food packaging and class B firefighting foams
